🔥 अरे भाई, थलाइवा का जलवा देख के बॉक्स ऑफिस हिल गया है!

सुपरस्टार रजनीकांत की एक्शन थ्रिलर फिल्म Jailer 2 ने थिएटर्स में दस दिन पूरे कर लिए हैं।
डिफ़ेंडर Nelson Dilipkumar की इस फिल्म ने दुनिया भर में कुल 675.15 करोड़ रुपये का ग्रॉस कलेक्शन कर लिया है।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, घरेलू नेट कलेक्शन 373 करोड़ रुपये और ग्रॉस 440.15 करोड़ रुपये पहुंच गया है।
विदेशों से फिल्म ने 235 करोड़ रुपये का बड़ा ग्रॉस कलेक्शन किया है।
खास बात ये है कि Tiger Muthuvel Pandian अब शंकर की फिल्म 2.0 के 691 करोड़ रुपये के रिकॉर्ड से सिर्फ 15.85 करोड़ रुपये दूर है।
फिल्म ने बजट की सौ फीसदी रिकवरी कर ली है और 23 करोड़ रुपये का नेट प्रॉफिट भी कमाया है।
क्या आपको लगता है कि Jailer 2 आज ही 2.0 का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ देगी? 🎟️✨

ctx.title: Jailer 2 Worldwide Box Office Day 10: Only 15.85 Crore Away From Reaching The Biggest Milestone In The History Of Tamil Cinema!
ctx.summary:
Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 is all set to hit the biggest milestone of Tamil Cinema as it crosses Jailer globally - day 10 worldwide box office report. 
 The post  Jailer 2 Worldwide Box Office Day 10: Only 15.85 Crore Away From Reaching The Biggest Milestone In The History Of Tamil Cinema!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The undisputed King of Tamil box office, Superstar Rajinikanth, is on the verge of writing absolute cinematic history! Director Nelson Dilipkumar’s action thriller Jailer 2 has completed an extraordinary 10-day run in theaters, delivering an unstoppable second weekend surge across domestic and international circuits. In 10 days, the global box office collection of the film stands at a gross total of 675.15 crore worldwide.
Rajinikanth has surpassed the worldwide box office collection of Jailer’s Lifetime. The predecessor of Nelson Dilipkumar ’s film completed its box office journey at a gross collection of 607.28 crore globally! The sequel now stands as the second-highest Kollywood film of all time globally!
With an explosive second Saturday showing, Jailer 2 has pushed its cumulative domestic net collection to 373 crore ( 440.15 crore gross ). Combined with a massive overseas gross haul of 235 crore , the film’s worldwide gross total now stands at an astonishing 675.15 crore ! With this phenomenal milestone, Tiger Muthuvel Pandian is now just 15.85 crore away from surpassing Shankar’s 2.0.
As soon as Rajinikanth crosses Shankar’s 2.0, which earned a gross collection of 691 crore worldwide, Rajinikanth will replace his own film, and Jailer sequel will claim the throne as the #1 Highest-Grossing Tamil Film of All Time Globally! Meanwhile, on the domestic front, the film has already claimed the success verdict with 100% budget recovery!
By comfortably surpassing its predecessor Jailer, Vijay’s Leo, Jailer 2 currently holds the #2 spot and is set to dethrone 2.0 within the next few hours!
